verdict.rationale: HumanLayer can turn GitHub/Jira/Linear issues into tasks and run an agent session (Oneshot workflow) to implement a fix, including via `humanlayer automation run` for unattended CI-triggered sessions, which supports autonomous bug-fix workflows. However the product's core design centers on human review checkpoints rather than fully unsupervised diagnose-and-fix, and there is no bug-diagnosis-specific example or end-to-end case study showing an agent independently root-causing and resolving a reported bug. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end bug-diagnosis-to-fix example, evidence of autonomous root-cause analysis (not just task creation/execution), and independent corroboration of successful unattended fixes.
